resolved.title: 一次编译，处处运行
resolved.description:
[s0l0!-header][h1]Write once, run anywhere[/h1][/s0l0!-header] 

Java's slogan is "[b]Write once, run anywhere[/b]".

This means that the same Java code can run on different platforms, including mobile, desktop and other portable systems.
resolved.description_en:
[s0l0!-header][h1]Write once, run anywhere[/h1][/s0l0!-header] 

Java's slogan is "[b]Write once, run anywhere[/b]".

This means that the same Java code can run on different platforms, including mobile, desktop and other portable systems.

content.text:
Java的口号是 "**一次编译，处处运行**"。

这意味着Java代码具有可移植性，同样的代码能够在不同的平台上运行，包括移动、桌面或其他系统。
content.text_html:
Java's slogan is "Write once, run anywhere".

This means that the same Java code can run on different platforms, including mobile, desktop and other portable systems.

Java的口号是 "**写一次，到处跑"。

这意味着同样的Java代码可以在不同的平台上运行，包括移动、桌面和其他便携系统。

resolved.title: 总结
resolved.description:
[s0l0!-header][h1]Lesson Takeaways[/h1][/s0l0!-header] 

Awesome! Now you know how to output text and numbers with Java!

Remember the following important points:
- Java is one of the most popular programming languages in the world
- Java is [b]platform-independent[/b], which means that you only need to write the program once to be able to run it on a number of different platforms and devices
- You can use [b]System.out.println() [/b]to send a message or output to the screen.
- In Java, each code [b]statement[/b] must end with a [b]semicolon[/b].
resolved.description_en:
[s0l0!-header][h1]Lesson Takeaways[/h1][/s0l0!-header] 

Awesome! Now you know how to output text and numbers with Java!

Remember the following important points:
- Java is one of the most popular programming languages in the world
- Java is [b]platform-independent[/b], which means that you only need to write the program once to be able to run it on a number of different platforms and devices
- You can use [b]System.out.println() [/b]to send a message or output to the screen.
- In Java, each code [b]statement[/b] must end with a [b]semicolon[/b].

content.text:
太棒了!👏
现在你知道如何用Java输出文本和数字了吧!

请记住以下几个要点：
- Java是世界上最流行的编程语言之一
- Java是**平台独立**的，意味着只需要写一次程序就能在许多不同的平台和设备上运行。
- 可以使用`System.out.println()`输出内柔到屏幕上。
- 在Java中，代码**语句**必须以**分号**`;`结束。
content.text_html:
Awesome! Now you know how to output text and numbers with Java!

Remember the following important points:

  • Java is one of the most popular programming languages in the world
  • Java is platform-independent, which means that you only need to write the program once to be able to run it on a number of different platforms and devices
  • You can use **System.out.println() **to send a message or output to the screen.
  • In Java, each code statement must end with a semicolon.

请记住以下几个要点：

  • Java是**平台独立的，这意味着你只需要写一次程序就能在许多不同的平台和设备上运行。
  • 你可以使用**System.out.println()**来发送消息或输出到屏幕上。
  • 在Java中，每个代码的语句必须以**分号结束。
